name: smwmusic-piyopiyoplayer-foreign-land
title: PiyoPiyoPlayer - Foreign Land
description:
An energectic song, made by Pixel on his spare time, in a collection of songs from PiyoPiyoPlayer. It was also intended to be played on Cave Story, on its early versions.

It does uses the KDL3 soundfont.

Original description by Pixel
Original:
○異郷："洞窟物語"で使う予定だった。
Rough translation:
• Foreign country: I was planning to use it in "Cave Story".
